title: McNamarah's Band
transcription:
McNamara's Band

My name is McNamarah
I'm the leader of the band,
Although we're few in number
we're the finest in the land,
We play at wakes and weddings
and at every fancy ball.
And if it can't be played by us,
it can't be played at all!

Chorus:
For the drums go bang and the cymbals
clang and the horns they blaze away.
McCarthy pumps the old bassoon
while I the pipes do play
And Hennessy Tennsey tootles the flute
and the music is something grand
A credit to old Ireland is
McNamara's band.

Accompaniment:
Ba da da da                    Boom boom

Ba da da da                    Boom boom

Ba da da da                    Boom boom

Da da da da                    Boom boom

Ba da da da                    Boom boom

Da da da da                    Boom boom

Da da da da da da da da da da da
Boom boom

Of course I am conductor
and we very often play
Before the great musicians
that you hear of every day.
When General Grant to Ireland came
and took me by the hand.
Says he, "I never heard the likes of
McNamarah's band."
